# CG-RES-004: Property added to closed response schema

A property was added to a response schema that promised no additional properties.

**Why it matters:** This is a policy decision, not a contract fact (§10.4).

| Attribute | Value |
|---|---|
| Area | [Responses](./#res) |
| Direction | response |
| Detects | `schema.propertyAdded` |
| Severity | breaking: high · potentially breaking: medium · undetermined: medium |
| Classification can be overridden | yes |

## Message

> Property "{property}" was added to closed {where}.
>
> The baseline promised no extra properties; strict validators will reject the new one, tolerant readers will not.
>
> **Fix:** Confirm that consumers do not validate responses strictly.

## Examples

Each example is an executed test case of the rule (`packages/engine/test/compat/fixtures.ts`).

### Fires: closed schema gains createdAt

```diff
  openapi: 3.1.0
  info: {title: t, version: v}
  paths:
    /x:
      get:
-       responses: {'200': {description: ok, content: {application/json: {schema: {type: object, additionalProperties: false, properties: {id: {}}}}}}}
+       responses: {'200': {description: ok, content: {application/json: {schema: {type: object, additionalProperties: false, properties: {id: {}, createdAt: {}}}}}}}
```

**Result:** Potentially breaking, medium. Property "createdAt" was added to closed GET /x: response 200 (application/json).

### Fires: closedResponseAdditions: breaking

With options: `{"policy":{"strictResponseValidation":false,"constraintTightening":"potentially-breaking","responseEnumAdditions":"potentially-breaking","removedRequestParameters":"non-breaking","closedResponseAdditions":"breaking"}}`

```diff
  openapi: 3.1.0
  info: {title: t, version: v}
  paths:
    /x:
      get:
-       responses: {'200': {description: ok, content: {application/json: {schema: {type: object, additionalProperties: false, properties: {id: {}}}}}}}
+       responses: {'200': {description: ok, content: {application/json: {schema: {type: object, additionalProperties: false, properties: {id: {}, createdAt: {}}}}}}}
```

**Result:** Breaking, high. Property "createdAt" was added to closed GET /x: response 200 (application/json).

### Does not fire: open schema

```diff
  openapi: 3.1.0
  info: {title: t, version: v}
  paths:
    /x:
      get:
-       responses: {'200': {description: ok, content: {application/json: {schema: {type: object, properties: {id: {}}}}}}}
+       responses: {'200': {description: ok, content: {application/json: {schema: {type: object, properties: {id: {}, createdAt: {}}}}}}}
```

**Result:** no finding from this rule.

## Limitations

- Whether consumers validate strictly is unknown.
